content.text:
I fixed two CSS regressions in `site/css/styles.css`. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

- **Section subheadings:** the italic line under each section title (e.g. "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur.") had grown to `1.5rem`. I set it back to `1rem`.
- **Timeline subheadings:** headings such as "Our Humble Beginnings" had picked up `text-transform: uppercase`, which also made some of them wrap onto two lines. I changed it back to `none`.

Together these had made the page 77px taller on desktop and 218px taller on phone.

STATUS: DONE
